tools.name: mapstudio_list_pieces
tools.description: [Map Studio] List the furniture and props you may place: id, size in metres, whether it blocks walking, tags.

tag.description: optional: only pieces with this tag or id part, e.g. medical, tavern, church, modern

tools.name: mapstudio_new_room
tools.description: [Map Studio] Start a room and save it under its name; then use {room:name} in apply_ops, validate, ascii and render. Returns the layout. x runs 0..w left to right, z runs 0..h top to bottom.

tools.name: mapstudio_apply_ops
tools.description: [Map Studio] Change the room with a list of operations. ops: set_style{style}, furnish{preset}, clear_props, add_piece{t,x,z,rot}, move_piece{index,x,z,rot}, remove_piece{index}, add_door{x,z,w,axis}, add_window{x,z,w,axis}, add_wall{a:[x,z],b:[x,z]}, add_thing{x,z,label,text,act,res}, set_npc{x,z,label}, set_start{x,z}. Errors say exactly what to fix.

room.description: name of a room made with new_room (preferred: you do not need to pass the layout)

layout.description: or the whole layout, if you have it

tools.name: mapstudio_validate
tools.description: [Map Studio] Check a layout: overlaps, pieces outside the room, doors or examine spots that cannot be reached.

room.description: name of a room made with new_room (preferred: you do not need to pass the layout)

layout.description: or the whole layout, if you have it

tools.name: mapstudio_ascii
tools.description: [Map Studio] Draw the room as text so you can see where things are. Use it after changes.

room.description: name of a room made with new_room (preferred: you do not need to pass the layout)

layout.description: or the whole layout, if you have it

tools.name: mapstudio_render
tools.description: [Map Studio] Render the room to a picture (jpg) and a map pack the game can use. Returns the file paths.

room.description: name of a room made with new_room (preferred: you do not need to pass the layout)

layout.description: or the whole layout, if you have it

tools.name: mapstudio_add_piece_type
tools.description: [Map Studio] Define a NEW piece from primitives: {id,name,tags,size:[w,d],block,parts:[{shape:box|cyl|cone|sphere,size:[w,h,d] or r,h or r,pos:[x,y,z],rot:[deg,deg,deg],mat:wood|dark|iron|brass|sheet|stone|brick|crate|canvas|red|metalBlue|or '#rrggbb'}]}. y is up; the piece stands on y=0 and is centred on x,z.

tools.name: mapstudio_map_case
tools.description: [Map Studio] Make maps for every scene of a written case (by id), automatically.

tools.name: mapstudio_list_presets
tools.description: [Map Studio] List the room presets for furnish{preset}: id, name and style. Grouped by era in MAPS.md.

tools.name: mapstudio_plan_case
tools.description: [Map Studio] Dry run: say which preset each scene of a written case would get, without drawing anything. Use before map_case.

tools.name: mapstudio_import_model
tools.description: [Map Studio] Add a .glb/.gltf 3D model file as a piece. Give file path, id, name, tags and height in metres (the size is measured).

tools.name: mapstudio_import_vtt
tools.description: [Map Studio] Convert a Dungeon Alchemist or Dungeondraft export (.dd2vtt/.uvtt) into a map pack.

tools.name: mapstudio_install_map
tools.description: [Map Studio] Put a rendered map pack into a scene of a written case, with optional spots {label:[x,z]}, npcs {id:[x,z]} and start [x,z].

tools.name: mapstudio_list_bust_parts
tools.description: [Map Studio] List every swappable part for a portrait bust (brows, eyes, mouths, noses, moustaches, beards, hair, hats, glasses, outfits) and the colour fields.

tools.name: mapstudio_suggest_bust
tools.description: [Map Studio] Pick a period-right portrait spec from what is known about a person. Same name gives the same face. Returns {spec}; edit it, then render_portrait.

origin.description: place or people, e.g. Burgundy, Lagos, Rajasthan

mood.description: neutral, worried, stern, happy or shocked

tools.name: mapstudio_render_portrait
tools.description: [Map Studio] Draw a portrait bust from a spec (see list_bust_parts) to a PNG in public/lab/portraits/. Returns the file paths.

tools.name: mapstudio_inspect_character_model
tools.description: [Map Studio] Check a character .glb (a base body or a part) against the rules in CHARACTER-IMPORT.md: size in metres, anchor_* nodes, material names, morph targets, skeleton. Returns problems to fix in the 3D app.

tools.name: mapstudio_import_character
tools.description: [Map Studio] Register a character model in the kit. kind base: a body with anchor_head, anchor_face and anchor_torso nodes (give height in metres). kind part: a hair, hat, glasses, brows, eyes, nose, mouth, moustache, beard, outfit or accessory piece (give slot, origin at its attach point; outfit may list base mesh names to hide). Returns warnings.

tools.name: mapstudio_list_character_kit
tools.description: [Map Studio] List the registered character bases and parts (ids, slots, tags).

tools.name: mapstudio_render_character
tools.description: [Map Studio] Assemble a character from the kit and draw a portrait (or full body) PNG. spec: { base, parts:{slot:partId}, colors:{skin,hair,cloth,cloth2,trim}, morphs:{name:0..1}, yaw }. view: portrait or full.

tools.name: mapstudio_import_models
tools.description: [Map Studio] Import a whole FOLDER of .glb models as pieces in one go (one measuring pass). Tags come from sub-folder names and `tags`; ids from file names. Set licensed:true for bought packs so models and piece files go to git-ignored places. FBX/OBJ/Unreal exports must be converted to .glb first.

pack.description: short pack name, used in ids and tags

height.description: scale every model so it is this tall (metres); omit if models are already in metres

block.description: force blocking on or off; default guessed from the name

tools.name: mapstudio_list_kits
tools.description: [Map Studio] List modular kits (wall, corner, door, window, floor pieces on a grid) a room can use with style.kit.

tools.name: mapstudio_register_kit
tools.description: [Map Studio] Define a modular kit from imported piece ids: { id, name, grid (metres one wall piece spans), wall, corner?, door?, window?, floor?, floorGrid?, licensed? }. Wall pieces face +z, centred on x, standing on y=0. Use it with apply_ops set_style { style: { kit: id } }.

tools.name: mapstudio_list_maps
tools.description: [Map Studio] List maps that already exist: with no case_id, the cases that have maps and standalone rooms; with a case_id, each scene's map file, spot and people counts and last-modified time. Check this before map_case, which overwrites.

tools.name: mapstudio_list_rooms
tools.description: [Map Studio] List the named rooms you have saved (made with new_room), with last-modified times.
